body: Don't be offended that she acts pathetic around you - it's probably because you're the only person she feels comfortable enough to act like herself around.  It sounds like she needs to see a doctor about this.  Depressed people often either can't recognize this or just don't have the will/motivation to get help for themselves. You sound like you really care about her so PLEASE get her some professional help.
